ai_review.summary: Recording is missing the expected “Row Jimmy” track and contains an incorrect “Ramble on Rose” from another show, rendering it unusable.
ai_review.review: The reviewer reports that the download lacks the promised “Row Jimmy” and instead includes a random “Ramble on Rose” taken from the 9/20/90 Photoleon matrix. No comments are made about the audio fidelity or performance because the tracklist is incorrect, making the recording essentially faulty.
